## Why it matters

This guide introduces AI concepts, research uses, and methodological risks in language aimed at historical work rather than general tech discussion.

Its multilingual format and focus on critical evaluation help researchers assess tools, document decisions, and reflect on evidence, bias, and reproducibility.
